title: Medications and diagnoses cleared within a year

tellings.quote: I was released from every single psychological diagnosises.

plain: A man named Jordan Jose, who says he was taken by a secret UFO program as a child, says that around 2010 to 2011, in Springville, New York, he came off his medications and within a year 'was released from every single' psychological diagnosis. He tells it about himself, as a sign that what he went through was not mental illness.
